messages:
eva: Quick sync — proposed recruitment playbook for the VPC private beta (small cohort, 6–8 partners). Goal: validate onboarding time, observability hooks, and SLA handoffs. Thoughts?
kevin: +1 to cohort size. recommend 3 verticals: fintech, healthcare, developer tooling.
sam: ops constraints: can only support 2 simultaneous on-prem installs in April due to infra capacity. need rollout windows.
nina: sales: we have 4 SIDs that match fintech/healthcare and are security-positive. can we offer 3 months free Dedicated + 10k credits?
mira: proposed incentives: 6 free engineering hours for integration + early access to caching/kv features + co-marketing. feedback cadence: weekly 30m sync + biweekly written survey + shared bug tracker.
eva: success criteria proposals:
- onboarding	target: <2 weeks to production-ready
- integration surface: API parity + observability hooks implemented
- quality: no more than 2 P0 regressions per partner in first 30 days
- adoption: 3 partners with daily traffic > 10k tokens/day
- business: 1 partner converts to paid Dedicated within 90 days
kevin: outreach DM template (short):
"Hi <name>, want to pilot a private VPC deployment with Redwood. We’ll provide eng support, credits, and observability integration. Interested?"
sam: operational checklist items:
- legal NDA template ready
- infra slot booking (calendar link)
- telemetry sampling and log retention config
- rollback and incident channels pre-defined
mira: feedback loop details:
- weekly: raw logs + perf dashboard
- every 2 weeks: product feedback doc (structured)
- monthly: data-driven evals (latency, cost, hallucination checks)
eva: negotiation floor for scope: we will not commit to model finetuning in beta; can do prompt-engineering support only. any objections?
nina: fine from sales. legal flagged data residency SLA — must be explicit in NDA.
deploy-bot: reminder: /run privacy-checklist VPC_BETA (bot) :white_check_mark:
kevin: suggest A/B of onboarding docs: 1) minimal steps, 2) deep-integrator guide. we can measure time-to-first-success.
eva: action items:
- mira: draft outreach list + DM copy by Tue
- sam: reserve infra slots and post calendar by Wed
- kevin: create onboarding doc variants
- nina: coordinate NDA + incentives language with legal
mira: noted, will post a short candidate matrix and outreach CSV in #product by EOD.
eva: thanks team — will run invite prioritization once outreach list is up. :rocket:
